_about: The 16 files whose filename names a different paper from the one inside (found at Checkpoint 3.1, listed in MISATTRIBUTED in capstone_checkpoint_3_1_evaluation.py). Each gets a citation label naming the paper actually in the file, read from its first page in the text cache on 2026-10-06. The index and the files are unchanged; only the label shown to the model and printed in citations changes. Label format: first author's surname, year, short name. Year is the first public date on page 1 (arXiv stamp where present).
